comments.author: Me
comments.body: Brandon, it depends on the particular TC and what skills it has modded in, the overall mods that are done to it and what purpose the buyer has in mind for it. Also whether or not an Original Ship's Skill has been added to it. As it is with any of the ships worth modding that far, what each player considers to be a well modded 5/5 TC varies quite a bit. Personally, I would say one that was built by a rank 20 Shipbuilder and stretched to maximum effective cargo, has Emergency Acceleration and Enhanced Ships Handling modded in, has full sails(+110 vertical and horizontal), a minimum of +2 Wave Resist so it can sail through a storm and High Lookout as Original Ships Skill would be a good 5/5 TC and even at that I would look for stuff like even more Wave Resist or some extra turn speed. Again though, that is personal preference, and honestly, what I would pay for or ask for one would vary as well from day to day. However, to give you a baseline figure for a ship like that, 100m would be a realistic price.
